nuggets.text: The Cardinals trace their roots to 1898 and are the oldest continuously run pro football franchise in the U.S.
The Cardinals got their name when the team's faded maroon jerseys were described as "Cardinal red."
First-year head coach Mike LaFleur's older brother, Matt, is the head coach of the Green Bay Packers.
Mike LaFleur played quarterback at Elmhurst for three seasons, then switched to safety as a senior.
No. 3 overall pick Jeremiyah Love created his own anime-inspired comic book series, called "Jeremonstar."
Jeremiyah Love broke Jerome Bettis's Notre Dame record with 21 total touchdowns in a single season.
Trey McBride caught 126 passes in 2025, the most ever by an NFL tight end in a single season.
Trey McBride is the first tight end in NFL history with back-to-back 100-catch seasons.
State Farm Stadium has a roll-in natural grass field and a fabric roof that opens in 12 minutes.
Rookie quarterback Carson Beck was a backup on Georgia's national championship teams in 2021 and 2022.
